boroBoro.description: A classic tobacco profile with warm honey sweetness and subtle woody notes.

cola.description: A familiar cola-inspired flavour with balanced sweetness, refreshing soda notes and a hint of caramel.

energyDrink.description: An energy drink-inspired flavour combining sweet, slightly tangy and refreshing notes.

espresso.description: A rich espresso flavour with bold coffee notes and a gently bitter finish.

frozenFruits.description: A chilled berry blend of blueberry, blackberry and wild strawberry with an icy cooling finish.

pomegranate.description: A ripe pomegranate flavour combining natural sweetness with a gently tart finish.

latakia.description: A distinctive tobacco flavour with deep smoky, woody and peppery notes.

mint.description: A fresh mint flavour with a pronounced menthol cooling sensation.

mojito.description: A mojito-inspired combination of lime, fresh mint and subtle rum-like sweetness.

ry4.description: A classic tobacco blend balanced with creamy vanilla and warm caramel notes.

satisfaction.description: A balanced combination of refreshing lemon, sweet cherry and classic tobacco notes.

strawberry.description: A sweet strawberry flavour with a fresh, authentic and fruity character.

tropicalFruits.description: An exotic blend of passion fruit, banana, pineapple, kiwi and papaya.

vanilla.description: A smooth, creamy vanilla flavour with warm sweetness and a soft aromatic finish.

virginia.description: A classic Virginia tobacco flavour with a rich, smooth and aromatic tobacco character.

watermelon.description: A ripe watermelon flavour with juicy sweetness and a light, refreshing finish.
